{"metadata":{"description":"Blue Glass Theme (ocean fantasy) for DeepSeek Harness Web — static profile bundle. 海洋幻想主题:海洋背景、玻璃气泡、海洋侧边栏、鲸鱼设置按钮、炫彩模型文字。安装: dsh plugin --profile web add github:chouxiaohuai/uiskin-theme","id":"gh:1337395971","install_available":true,"language":"JavaScript","name":"dsh-uiskin-theme","slug":"chouxiaohuai/dsh-uiskin-theme","topics":["deepseek-harness","deepseek-harness-plugin","dsh","dsh-plugin","theme","theme-ui"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"Blue Glass Theme (ocean fantasy) for DeepSeek Harness Web — static profile bundle. 海洋幻想主题:海洋背景、玻璃气泡、"},{"id":"p1s2","text":"海洋侧边栏、鲸鱼设置按钮、炫彩模型文字。安装: dsh plugin --profile web add github:chouxiaohuai/uiskin-theme"},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# uiskin-theme — Blue Glass Theme / 海洋幻想主题"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"**uiskin-theme** is a **static plugin bundle (profile bundle)** for DeepSeek Harness Web: a crisp oc"},{"id":"p3s2","text":"ean background, glass bubbles, an ocean-styled sidebar (with a gold-gradient「HARNESS」wordmark and a "},{"id":"p3s3","text":"bottom cartoon character), a whale settings button, gradient model text, a one-click **light/dark th"},{"id":"p3s4","text":"eme toggle** on the conversation header, and a **purple live thinking-time counter** beside 深度求索中…."},{"id":"p4s1","text":"**uiskin-theme** 是 DeepSeek Harness Web 的**静态插件包（profile bundle）**：清澈的海洋背景、玻璃气泡、海洋侧边栏（含金色渐变「HARNESS」"},{"id":"p4s2","text":"字标与底部卡通角色）、鲸鱼设置按钮、渐变模型文字、会话头部一键切换**明/暗主题**按钮，以及「深度求索中…」旁边醒目的**紫色实时思考秒数**。"},{"id":"p5s1","text":"Unlike dynamic plugins (`cordis_define` defined at runtime, lost on restart), this package is instal"},{"id":"p5s2","text":"led into the profile as an npm package: **it loads automatically on every start, survives restarts, "},{"id":"p5s3","text":"and needs no manual approval**."},{"id":"p6s1","text":"与动态插件（`cordis_define` 现场定义、重启即丢）不同，本包以 npm 包形式装进 profile，**每次启动自动加载，重启不丢，无需人工批准**。"},{"id":"p7s1","text":"> **License / 许可证**
> This theme is an original work and is **All Rights Reserved** — it is NOT open"},{"id":"p7s2","text":" source.
> Without written permission from the author, you may not copy, modify, redistribute, creat"},{"id":"p7s3","text":"e derivative works, or use it commercially; it may only be installed as-is and used personally.
>
> "},{"id":"p7s4","text":"本主题为原创作品，**保留所有权利（All Rights Reserved）**，非开源协议。
> 未经作者书面许可，不得复制、修改、再分发、二次创作或用于商业用途；仅允许按原样安装与个人使用。"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"## Installation / 安装"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"You need Node.js and pnpm, plus a working `dsh` CLI (`npx @deepseek-ai/dsh` also works)."},{"id":"p10s1","text":"需要已安装 Node.js 与 pnpm，并已能运行 `dsh` CLI（`npx @deepseek-ai/dsh` 亦可）。"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"After installing, restart `dsh web` (or it takes effect on the next start)."},{"id":"p13s1","text":"装完后重启 `dsh web`（或下次启动时）即自动生效。"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"What the install does: `dsh plugin` runs pnpm inside `~/.dsh/profiles/web/`, sees the package's `dsh"},{"id":"p14s2","text":".bundle.patch` declaration, adds it to `dsh.profile.bundles`, and it is loaded by boot at startup."},{"id":"p15s1","text":"安装做了什么：`dsh plugin` 会在 `~/.dsh/profiles/web/` 里执行 pnpm 安装，识别到包的 `dsh.bundle.patch` 声明后把它加入 `dsh.prof"},{"id":"p15s2","text":"ile.bundles`，启动时由 boot 加载。"},{"id":"p16s1","text":"## Uninstall / 卸载"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p18s1","text":"> **Repo name vs package name / 仓库名与包名**
> The GitHub repository is `dsh-uiskin-theme` (previously `"},{"id":"p18s2","text":"uiskin-theme`), while the installed **package name** is `uiskin-theme` (from the `name` field of `pa"},{"id":"p18s3","text":"ckage.json`). So install with `github:USERNAME/dsh-uiskin-theme` and uninstall with `remove uiskin-t"},{"id":"p18s4","text":"heme`.
>
> GitHub 仓库为 `dsh-uiskin-theme`（曾用名 `uiskin-theme`），而安装后的**插件包名**是 `uiskin-theme`（取自 `packa"},{"id":"p18s5","text":"ge.json` 的 `name`）。因此安装用 `github:USERNAME/dsh-uiskin-theme`，卸载用 `remove uiskin-theme`。"},{"id":"p19s1","text":"## How it works / 工作原理"},{"id":"p20s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p21s1","text":"## Local development / rebuild / 本地开发 / 重新构建"},{"id":"p22s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p23s1","text":"To restyle the theme, edit the CSS / components in `scripts/client.template.js`, or replace the imag"},{"id":"p23s2","text":"es under `assets/` and rebuild. **Remember to commit `lib/client.js` along with the change** — someo"},{"id":"p23s3","text":"ne installing from git will not (and does not need to) run the build script."},{"id":"p24s1","text":"修改皮肤请编辑 `scripts/client.template.js` 里的 CSS / 组件，或替换 `assets/` 下的图片后重新构建。**改完记得把 `lib/client.js` 一起提"},{"id":"p24s2","text":"交**——别人从 git 安装时不会（也不需要）执行构建脚本。"},{"id":"p25s1","text":"## Notes / 注意事项"},{"id":"p26s1","text":"- Assets are inlined as base64 into `lib/client.js` (~1.1 MB) and loaded once, suitable for small sk"},{"id":"p26s2","text":"in images. To shrink it, compress the images under `assets/` first and rebuild.
- 素材以 base64 内联在 `li"},{"id":"p26s3","text":"b/client.js`（约 1.1 MB），加载一次即可，适合皮肤类小图片。若想更小，可先把 `assets/` 里的图压缩再构建。
- DSH is currently a `0.1.5-rc.1"},{"id":"p26s4","text":"` pre-release; the plugin API (`dsh.bundle` / `dsh.client` / slots / theme services) and some client"},{"id":"p26s5","text":" class names may change between releases. When upgrading DSH, a few theme elements (bubbles, sidebar"},{"id":"p26s6","text":") can briefly lose styling if their CSS class hashes change — this theme tracks those renames and ad"},{"id":"p26s7","text":"ds the matching selectors. If you hit compatibility issues after upgrading DSH, watch this repo's up"},{"id":"p26s8","text":"dates.
- DSH 目前是 `0.1.5-rc.1` 预发布版本，插件 API（`dsh.bundle` / `dsh.client` / slots / theme 服务）及部分客户端类名可能"},{"id":"p26s9","text":"随版本变化。升级 DSH 后，个别主题元素（气泡、侧栏）可能因类名 hash 变化而暂时失去样式——本主题会跟踪这些改名并补充对应选择器；如升级后遇兼容问题，关注本仓库的更新。
- This pack"},{"id":"p26s10","text":"age only depends on `@deepseek-ai/cordis` (peer) and `react` (peer); no `allowBuilds` approval is ne"},{"id":"p26s11","text":"eded to run its build scripts.
- 本包只依赖 `@deepseek-ai/cordis`（peer）与 `react`（peer），无需 `allowBuilds` 放"},{"id":"p26s12","text":"o run its build scripts.
- 本包只依赖 `@deepseek-ai/cordis`（peer）与 `react`（peer），无需 `allowBuilds` 放行构建脚本。"},{"id":"p27s1","text":"## Other / 其他"},{"id":"p28s1","text":"- Making this takes effort, and your support is what drives us. If you like it, please give it a sta"},{"id":"p28s2","text":"r; for suggestions or bugs, contact shutiaochou@gmail.com.
- 制作不易，您的支持才是我们开发的动力。如果喜欢，欢迎点一个 star；如需提建"},{"id":"p28s3","text":"议或反馈 Bug，请联系 shutiaochou@gmail.com。"}],"truncated":false}
